g.text: User inputs one new coordinate group and a label\nWhen cartesian coordinates are input, the corresponding polar is calculated \nWhen polar coordinates are input, the corresponding cartesian is calculated
Developed using Java with the Swing framework\nUser interaction for inputting coordinate groups, labels, and selecting operations.
MySQL connection for persistent storage of CoordinateGroups.\nTCP/IP protocol is used for communication between the application and the database.
